Sexual Offences Definitive Guideline 81
Effective from 1 April 2014
CAUSING, INCITING OR CONTROLLING PROSTITUTION FOR GAIN
Causing or inciting prostitution
for gain
Sexual Offences Act 2003 (section 52)
Controlling prostitution for gain
Sexual Offences Act 2003 (section 53)
Triable either way
Maximum: 7 years’ custody
Offence range: Community order – 6 years’ custody
For convictions on or after 3 December 2012 (irrespective of the date of commission of the
offence), these are specified offences for the purposes of section 226A (extended sentence for
certain violent or sexual offences) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003.
The terms “prostitute” and “prostitution” are used in this guideline in accordance with the statutory language
contained in the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
